verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a CLI coding assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. General config options (CLI flags, .aider.conf.yml, AIDER_xxx env vars) and local-model support are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
